sanskrit: tato māṃ tejasāviśya mohayitvā ca bhānumān uvāca bhavitā putras tavety abhyagamad divam
english: Then the Sun, entering me with his radiance and clouding my senses, said, 'A son shall be yours,' and ascended to heaven.

sanskrit: tato 'ham antarbhavane pitur vṛttāntarakṣiṇī gūḍhotpannaṃ sutaṃ bālaṃ jale karṇam avāsṛjam
english: Then, within my father's palace, guarding the secret of what had passed, I set adrift upon the water the infant son secretly born—Karṇa.

sanskrit: nūnaṃ tasyaiva devasya prasādāt punar eva tu kanyāham abhavaṃ vipra yathā prāha sa mām ṛṣiḥ
english: Surely, O brāhmaṇa, by the grace of that very god I became a maiden once again, even as the sage had foretold to me.

sanskrit: sa mayā mūḍhayā putro jñāyamāno 'py upekṣitaḥ tan māṃ dahati viprarṣe yathā suviditaṃ tava
english: Foolish that I was, I forsook that son though I knew him to be mine—and that, O sage among brāhmaṇas, burns me, as you well know.

sanskrit: yadi pāpam apāpaṃ vā tad etad vivṛtaṃ mayā tan me bhayaṃ tvaṃ bhagavan vyapanetum ihārhasi
english: Whether it be sin or no sin, I have laid it all bare before you. You, revered one, ought now to take away this fear of mine.

sanskrit: yac cāsya rājño viditaṃ hṛdisthaṃ bhavato 'nagha taṃ cāyaṃ labhatāṃ kāmam adyaiva munisattama
english: And that wish which dwells in this king's heart, known to you, O sinless and best of sages—let him obtain it this very day.

sanskrit: ity uktaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ vyāso vedavidāṃ varaḥ sādhu sarvam idaṃ tathyam evam eva yathāttha mām
english: Thus addressed, Vyāsa, foremost of those who know the Vedas, replied: 'It is well. All this is true, just as you have told me.'

sanskrit: aparādhaś ca te nāsti kanyābhāvaṃ gatā hy asi devāś caiśvaryavanto vai śarīrāṇy āviśanti vai
english: 'No fault lies with you, for you regained your maidenhood. The gods, indeed, in their lordly power, enter into bodies.'

sanskrit: santi devanikāyāś ca saṃkalpāj janayanti ye vācā dṛṣṭyā tathā sparśāt saṃgharṣeṇeti pañcadhā
english: 'There are orders of gods who beget offspring by will alone, by word, by glance, by touch, and by union—thus in five ways.'

sanskrit: manuṣyadharmo daivena dharmeṇa na hi yujyate iti kunti vyajānīhi vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ
english: 'The law of men cannot be measured by the law of the gods. Know this, O Kuntī, and let the fever of your mind depart.'

sanskrit: sarvaṃ balavatāṃ pathyaṃ sarvaṃ balavatāṃ śuci sarvaṃ balavatāṃ dharmaḥ sarvaṃ balavatāṃ svakam
english: 'For the mighty all is wholesome, for the mighty all is pure, for the mighty all is righteous, for the mighty all is their own.'

sanskrit: vyāsa uvāca bhadre drakṣyasi gāndhāri putrān bhrātṝn sakhīṃs tathā vadhūś ca patibhiḥ sārdhaṃ niśi suptotthitā iva
english: Vyāsa said: Gracious Gāndhārī, you shall behold your sons, your brothers, your friends, and your daughters-in-law together with their husbands tonight, as though they had risen from sleep.

sanskrit: karṇaṃ drakṣyati kuntī ca saubhadraṃ cāpi yādavī draupadī pañca putrāṃś ca pitṝn bhrātṝṃs tathaiva ca
english: Kuntī shall behold Karṇa, and the Yādava lady Subhadrā her son Abhimanyu; Draupadī shall see her five sons, her fathers, and her brothers as well.

sanskrit: pūrvam evaiṣa hṛdaye vyavasāyo 'bhavan mama yathāsmi codito rājñā bhavatyā pṛthayaiva ca
english: This resolve had already arisen in my heart before, even as I have now been urged by the king, by you, and by Pṛthā herself.

sanskrit: na te śocyā mahātmānaḥ sarva eva nararṣabhāḥ kṣatradharmaparāḥ santas tathā hi nidhanaṃ gatāḥ
english: Those great-souled men, every one of those bulls among warriors, are not to be mourned, for devoted to the warrior's duty they met their end.

sanskrit: bhavitavyam avaśyaṃ tat surakāryam anindite avaterus tataḥ sarve devabhāgair mahītalam
english: That which had to be was inevitable, a work of the gods, O blameless one; for all of them descended to the earth as portions of divine beings.

sanskrit: gandharvāpsarasaś caiva piśācā guhyarākṣasāḥ tathā puṇyajanāś caiva siddhā devarṣayo 'pi ca
english: Gandharvas and apsarases, piśācas, guhyakas, and rākṣasas, the holy yakṣas, the siddhas, and the divine seers as well—

sanskrit: devāś ca dānavāś caiva tathā brahmarṣayo 'malāḥ ta ete nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ kurukṣetre raṇājire
english: gods and dānavas too, and the stainless brahmā-seers—all these met their death on the battlefield of Kurukṣetra.

sanskrit: gandharvarājo yo dhīmān dhṛtarāṣṭra iti śrutaḥ sa eva mānuṣe loke dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ patis tava
english: That wise king of the gandharvas known by the name Dhṛtarāṣṭra—he it is who in the world of men is Dhṛtarāṣṭra, your husband.

sanskrit: pāṇḍuṃ marudgaṇaṃ viddhi viśiṣṭatamam acyutam dharmasyāṃśo 'bhavat kṣattā rājā cāyaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: Know Pāṇḍu to have been the most excellent and steadfast among the host of the Maruts; Vidura was a portion of Dharma, and so too is this king Yudhiṣṭhira.

sanskrit: kaliṃ duryodhanaṃ viddhi śakuniṃ dvāparaṃ tathā duḥśāsanādīn viddhi tvaṃ rākṣasāñ śubhadarśane
english: Know Duryodhana to have been Kali, and Śakuni the Dvāpara age; and Duḥśāsana and the rest, O fair-faced one, know them to have been rākṣasas.

sanskrit: marudgaṇād bhīmasenaṃ balavantam ariṃdamam viddhi ca tvaṃ naram ṛṣim imaṃ pārthaṃ dhanaṃjayam nārāyaṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśam aśvinau yamajāv ubhau
english: Know the mighty subduer of foes, Bhīmasena, to have sprung from the host of the Maruts; this Pārtha, Dhanaṃjaya, was the seer Nara; Hṛṣīkeśa was Nārāyaṇa; and the twins were the two Aśvins.

sanskrit: dvidhā kṛtvātmano deham ādityaṃ tapatāṃ varam lokāṃś ca tāpayānaṃ vai viddhi karṇaṃ ca śobhane yaś ca vairārtham udbhūtaḥ saṃgharṣajananas tathā
english: Know Karṇa, O lovely one, to have been the Sun—first among the burning ones, who, dividing his own body in two, scorches the worlds—he who was born to be the cause of enmity and to kindle strife.

sanskrit: yaś ca pāṇḍavadāyādo hataḥ ṣaḍbhir mahārathaiḥ sa soma iha saubhadro yogād evābhavad dvidhā
english: And that heir of the Pāṇḍavas, slain by six great chariot-warriors—Subhadrā's son—was the Moon, who by his yogic power had become twofold here.

sanskrit: draupadyā saha saṃbhūtaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca pāvakāt agner bhāgaṃ śubhaṃ viddhi rākṣasaṃ tu śikhaṇḍinam
english: Know Dhṛṣṭadyumna, born with Draupadī from the sacred fire, to have been an auspicious portion of Agni; but Śikhaṇḍin was a rākṣasa.

sanskrit: droṇaṃ bṛhaspater bhāgaṃ viddhi drauṇiṃ ca rudrajam bhīṣmaṃ ca viddhi gāṅgeyaṃ vasuṃ mānuṣatāṃ gatam
english: Know Droṇa to have been a portion of Bṛhaspati, and Droṇa's son born of Rudra; and know Bhīṣma, the son of Gaṅgā, to have been a Vasu come to the state of man.

sanskrit: evam ete mahāprājñe devā mānuṣyam etya hi tataḥ punar gatāḥ svargaṃ kṛte karmaṇi śobhane
english: Thus, O most wise lady, these gods, having come to the human condition and accomplished their glorious task, returned again to heaven.

sanskrit: yac ca vo hṛdi sarveṣāṃ duḥkham enac ciraṃ sthitam tad adya vyapaneṣyāmi paralokakṛtād bhayāt
english: And this grief that has long dwelt in the hearts of all of you—the dread born of thought for the other world—I shall today drive away.

sanskrit: sarve bhavanto gacchantu nadīṃ bhāgīrathīṃ prati tatra drakṣyatha tān sarvān ye hatāsmin raṇājire
english: Let all of you go down to the river Bhāgīrathī. There you shall behold all those who fell upon this field of battle.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca iti vyāsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā sarvo janas tadā mahatā siṃhanādena gaṅgām abhimukho yayau
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having heard these words of Vyāsa, all the people then, with a great lion's roar, set forth toward the Gaṅgā.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca sāmātyaḥ prayayau saha pāṇḍavaiḥ sahito muniśārdūlair gandharvaiś ca samāgataiḥ
english: And Dhṛtarāṣṭra, with his ministers, set out together with the Pāṇḍavas, accompanied by the tigers among sages and by the assembled gandharvas.

sanskrit: tato gaṅgāṃ samāsādya krameṇa sa janārṇavaḥ nivāsam akarot sarvo yathāprīti yathāsukham
english: Then, having reached the Gaṅgā in due order, that whole ocean of people made their dwelling, each as he pleased and at his ease.

sanskrit: rājā ca pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdham iṣṭe deśe sahānugaḥ nivāsam akarod dhīmān sastrīvṛddhapuraḥsaraḥ
english: And the wise king, together with the Pāṇḍavas and his followers, made his dwelling in a chosen spot, with the women and the elders at the fore.

sanskrit: jagāma tad ahaś cāpi teṣāṃ varṣaśataṃ yathā niśāṃ pratīkṣamāṇānāṃ didṛkṣūṇāṃ mṛtān nṛpān
english: And that day passed like a hundred years for them as they awaited the night, longing to behold the kings who had died.

sanskrit: atha puṇyaṃ girivaram astam abhyagamad raviḥ tataḥ kṛtābhiṣekās te naiśaṃ karma samācaran
english: Then the sun went down behind the sacred peak of the foremost mountain; and they, having performed their ablutions, set about the rites of the night.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tato niśāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ kṛtasāyāhnikakriyāḥ vyāsam abhyagaman sarve ye tatrāsan samāgatāḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then, when night had come and the evening rites were done, all who were gathered there approached Vyāsa.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭras tu dharmātmā pāṇḍavaiḥ sahitas tadā śucir ekamanāḥ sārdham ṛṣibhis tair upāviśat
english: And the righteous Dhṛtarāṣṭra, together with the Pāṇḍavas, purified and single-minded, sat down with those sages.

sanskrit: gāndhāryā saha nāryas tu sahitāḥ samupāviśan paurajānapadaś cāpi janaḥ sarvo yathāvayaḥ
english: With Gāndhārī the women sat down together, and all the folk of city and countryside as well, each according to his age.

sanskrit: tato vyāso mahātejāḥ puṇyaṃ bhāgīrathījalam avagāhyājuhāvātha sarvāṃl lokān mahāmuniḥ
english: Then the mighty-splendored Vyāsa, the great sage, having entered the holy water of the Bhāgīrathī, summoned forth all the realms of beings.

sanskrit: pāṇḍavānāṃ ca ye yodhāḥ kauravāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ rājānaś ca mahābhāgā nānādeśanivāsinaḥ
english: the warriors of the Pāṇḍavas and of the Kauravas, all of them, and the illustrious kings who dwelt in many lands—

sanskrit: tataḥ sutumulaḥ śabdo jalāntar janamejaya prādurāsīd yathā pūrvaṃ kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ
english: Then, O Janamejaya, a tremendous tumult arose from within the water, even as of old between the armies of the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: tatas te pārthivāḥ sarve bhīṣmadroṇapurogamāḥ sasainyāḥ salilāt tasmāt samuttasthuḥ sahasraśaḥ
english: Then all those kings, led by Bhīṣma and Droṇa, rose up from that water by the thousands, together with their armies.

sanskrit: virāṭadrupadau cobhau saputrau sahasainikau draupadeyāś ca saubhadro rākṣasaś ca ghaṭotkacaḥ
english: Both Virāṭa and Drupada, with their sons and their soldiers, and the sons of Draupadī, and Subhadrā's son, and the rākṣasa Ghaṭotkaca;

sanskrit: karṇaduryodhanau cobhau śakuniś ca mahārathaḥ duḥśāsanādayaś caiva dhārtarāṣṭrā mahārathāḥ
english: both Karṇa and Duryodhana, and Śakuni the great chariot-warrior, and Duḥśāsana and the rest, the great car-warriors among the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra;

sanskrit: jārāsaṃdhir bhagadatto jalasaṃdhaś ca pārthivaḥ bhūriśravāḥ śalaḥ śalyo vṛṣasenaś ca sānujaḥ
english: the son of Jarāsaṃdha, Bhagadatta, and king Jalasaṃdha, Bhūriśravas, Śala, Śalya, and Vṛṣasena with his younger brother;

sanskrit: lakṣmaṇo rājaputraś ca dhṛṣṭadyumnasya cātmajāḥ śikhaṇḍiputrāḥ sarve ca dhṛṣṭaketuś ca sānujaḥ
english: the prince Lakṣmaṇa, and the sons of Dhṛṣṭadyumna, and all the sons of Śikhaṇḍin, and Dhṛṣṭaketu with his younger brother;

sanskrit: acalo vṛṣakaś caiva rākṣasaś cāpy alāyudhaḥ bāhlīkaḥ somadattaś ca cekitānaś ca pārthivaḥ
english: Acala and Vṛṣaka, and the rākṣasa Alāyudha, Bāhlika and Somadatta, and king Cekitāna;

sanskrit: ete cānye ca bahavo bahutvād ye na kīrtitāḥ sarve bhāsuradehās te samuttasthur jalāt tataḥ
english: these and many others, who for their multitude are not named, all of radiant form, rose up then from the water.

sanskrit: yasya vīrasya yo veṣo yo dhvajo yac ca vāhanam tena tena vyadṛśyanta samupetā narādhipāḥ
english: Whatever garb, whatever banner, and whatever mount belonged to each hero—by these very tokens were the lords of men beheld, each fully arrayed.

sanskrit: divyāmbaradharāḥ sarve sarve bhrājiṣṇukuṇḍalāḥ nirvairā nirahaṃkārā vigatakrodhamanyavaḥ
english: All clad in celestial raiment, all with gleaming earrings, free of enmity, free of pride, their anger and resentment gone.

sanskrit: gandharvair upagīyantaḥ stūyamānāś ca bandibhiḥ divyamālyāmbaradharā vṛtāś cāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ
english: hymned by gandharvas and praised by bards, wearing celestial garlands and robes, encircled by throngs of apsarases.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭrasya ca tadā divyaṃ cakṣur narādhipa muniḥ satyavatīputraḥ prītaḥ prādāt tapobalāt
english: And then, O lord of men, the sage, son of Satyavatī, well pleased, by the power of his austerities bestowed divine sight upon Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

sanskrit: divyajñānabalopetā gāndhārī ca yaśasvinī dadarśa putrāṃs tān sarvān ye cānye 'pi raṇe hatāḥ
english: And the glorious Gāndhārī, endowed with the power of divine vision, beheld all those her sons and the others as well who had been slain in battle.

sanskrit: tad adbhutam acintyaṃ ca sumahad romaharṣaṇam vismitaḥ sa janaḥ sarvo dadarśānimiṣekṣaṇaḥ
english: That marvel, beyond thought, immense and hair-raising, all those people gazed upon in wonder, their eyes unblinking.

sanskrit: tad utsavamadodagraṃ hṛṣṭanārīnarākulam dadṛśe balam āyāntaṃ citraṃ paṭagataṃ yathā
english: That host was seen approaching, exultant as at a festival, thronged with rejoicing women and men, splendid as a painting upon a canvas.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭras tu tān sarvān paśyan divyena cakṣuṣā mumude bharataśreṣṭha prasādāt tasya vai muneḥ
english: And Dhṛtarāṣṭra, beholding all of them with his divine eye, rejoiced, O best of the Bhāratas, by the grace of that sage.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tatas te bharataśreṣṭhāḥ samājagmuḥ parasparam vigatakrodhamātsaryāḥ sarve vigatakalmaṣāḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then those best of the Bhāratas came together with one another, all of them with anger and envy gone, freed from every stain.

sanskrit: vidhiṃ paramam āsthāya brahmarṣivihitaṃ śubham saṃprītamanasaḥ sarve devaloka ivāmarāḥ
english: Following the supreme and auspicious ordinance laid down by the brahmā-seer, all glad of heart, like the immortals in the world of the gods.

sanskrit: putraḥ pitrā ca mātrā ca bhāryā ca patinā saha bhrātā bhrātrā sakhā caiva sakhyā rājan samāgatāḥ
english: Son with father and with mother, wife together with husband, brother with brother, and friend with friend, O king, were reunited.

sanskrit: pāṇḍavās tu maheṣvāsaṃ karṇaṃ saubhadram eva ca saṃpraharṣāt samājagmur draupadeyāṃś ca sarvaśaḥ
english: And the Pāṇḍavas, in their great joy, came together with the mighty archer Karṇa and with Subhadrā's son, and with all the sons of Draupadī.

sanskrit: tatas te prīyamāṇā vai karṇena saha pāṇḍavāḥ sametya pṛthivīpālāḥ sauhṛde 'vasthitābhavan
english: Then those Pāṇḍavas, those guardians of the earth, full of affection, having met with Karṇa, came to abide in friendship with him.

sanskrit: ṛṣiprasādāt te 'nye ca kṣatriyā naṣṭamanyavaḥ asauhṛdaṃ parityajya sauhṛde paryavasthitāḥ
english: By the grace of the sage, those other warriors too, their wrath destroyed, cast off all enmity and came to stand in friendship.

sanskrit: evaṃ samāgatāḥ sarve gurubhir bāndhavais tathā putraiś ca puruṣavyāghrāḥ kuravo 'nye ca mānavāḥ
english: Thus were all those tigers among men reunited—with their elders, their kinsmen, and their sons—the Kurus and the other folk besides.

sanskrit: tāṃ rātrim ekāṃ kṛtsnāṃ te vihṛtya prītamānasāḥ menire paritoṣeṇa nṛpāḥ svargasado yathā
english: Having passed that one whole night in delight, glad of heart, those kings in their contentment deemed themselves dwellers in heaven.

sanskrit: nātra śoko bhayaṃ trāso nāratir nāyaśo 'bhavat parasparaṃ samāgamya yodhānāṃ bharatarṣabha
english: There was no grief, no fear, no terror, no discontent nor any disgrace, O bull of the Bhāratas, when the warriors met one another.

sanskrit: samāgatās tāḥ pitṛbhir bhrātṛbhiḥ patibhiḥ sutaiḥ mudaṃ paramikāṃ prāpya nāryo duḥkham athātyajan
english: Reunited with their fathers, their brothers, their husbands, and their sons, the women, attaining the highest joy, then cast off their sorrow.

sanskrit: ekāṃ rātriṃ vihṛtyaivaṃ te vīrās tāś ca yoṣitaḥ āmantryānyonyam āśliṣya tato jagmur yathāgatam
english: Having thus passed one night, those heroes and those women, taking leave of one another and embracing, then departed as they had come.

sanskrit: tato visarjayām āsa lokāṃs tān munipuṃgavaḥ kṣaṇenāntarhitāś caiva prekṣatām eva te 'bhavan
english: Then that bull among sages dismissed those hosts of beings, and in an instant they vanished, even as the onlookers watched.

sanskrit: avagāhya mahātmānaḥ puṇyāṃ tripathagāṃ nadīm sarathāḥ sadhvajāś caiva svāni sthānāni bhejire
english: Plunging into the holy river that flows by three paths, those great souls, with their chariots and their banners, betook themselves to their own abodes.

sanskrit: devalokaṃ yayuḥ ke cit ke cid brahmasadas tathā ke cic ca vāruṇaṃ lokaṃ ke cit kauberam āpnuvan
english: Some went to the world of the gods, some to the assembly of Brahmā, some attained the world of Varuṇa, and some that of Kubera.

sanskrit: tathā vaivasvataṃ lokaṃ ke cic caivāpnuvan nṛpāḥ rākṣasānāṃ piśācānāṃ ke cic cāpy uttarān kurūn
english: And some of those kings attained the world of Vaivasvata, some that of the rākṣasas and piśācas, and some the Northern Kurus.

sanskrit: vicitragatayaḥ sarve yā avāpyāmaraiḥ saha ājagmus te mahātmānaḥ savāhāḥ sapadānugāḥ
english: By wondrous paths they all departed—those great souls who had come with the immortals, together with their mounts and their attendants on foot.

sanskrit: gateṣu teṣu sarveṣu salilastho mahāmuniḥ dharmaśīlo mahātejāḥ kurūṇāṃ hitakṛt sadā tataḥ provāca tāḥ sarvāḥ kṣatriyā nihateśvarāḥ
english: When all of them had departed, the great sage standing in the water—righteous in conduct, of mighty splendor, ever the benefactor of the Kurus—then spoke to all those warrior-women whose lords had been slain.

sanskrit: yā yāḥ patikṛtāṃl lokān icchanti paramastriyaḥ tā jāhnavījalaṃ kṣipram avagāhantv atandritāḥ
english: Whichever of these noble women desire the worlds won by their husbands, let them without delay and without sloth plunge into the water of the Jāhnavī.

sanskrit: tatas tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śraddadhānā varāṅganāḥ śvaśuraṃ samanujñāpya viviśur jāhnavījalam
english: Then, hearing his words, those fair women, full of faith, having taken leave of their father-in-law, entered the water of the Jāhnavī.

sanskrit: vimuktā mānuṣair dehais tatas tā bhartṛbhiḥ saha samājagmus tadā sādhvyaḥ sarvā eva viśāṃ pate
english: Freed from their human bodies, those virtuous women then, O lord of peoples, were every one reunited with their husbands.

sanskrit: evaṃ krameṇa sarvās tāḥ śīlavatyaḥ kulastriyaḥ praviśya toyaṃ nirmuktā jagmur bhartṛsalokatām
english: Thus, one after another, all those virtuous women of noble houses, entering the water and liberated, attained to the same world as their husbands.

sanskrit: divyarūpasamāyuktā divyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ divyamālyāmbaradharā yathāsāṃ patayas tathā
english: Endowed with celestial forms, adorned with celestial ornaments, wearing celestial garlands and raiment—even as were their husbands, so were they.

sanskrit: tāḥ śīlasattvasaṃpannā vitamaskā gataklamāḥ sarvāḥ sarvaguṇair yuktāḥ svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ prapedire
english: Endowed with virtue and goodness, free of darkness and weariness, all of them graced with every excellence, they reached each her own abode.

sanskrit: yasya yasya ca yaḥ kāmas tasmin kāle 'bhavat tadā taṃ taṃ visṛṣṭavān vyāso varado dharmavatsalaḥ
english: And whatever wish belonged to each at that time, that very wish Vyāsa, the bestower of boons, devoted to righteousness, then granted to each.
